red.shape: unrelated explicit-user completion_result during active notify IS currently suppressed (RED witness)

root_cause: Class B — TOOLCALL_JOB_MAPPING_NOT_THREADED. The C10 completion-result filter at sdk-session-event-coordinator.ts:514-535 consulted the AGGREGATE predicate `outstandingAutonomousWork = activeNotifyCount > 0 || pendingPromptsKnown > 0 || pendingPromptAuthorityUnknown` which cannot distinguish 'completion belongs to active job J' from 'completion belongs to unrelated work K'. The jobId minted at vscode-run-commands-tool.ts:768 was registered with the BackgroundNotifyCoordinator but never threaded back into the C10 filter.
ownership_signal: existing signal — `BackgroundNotifyCoordinator.notificationMarkers: Map<jobId, NotificationMarker>` keyed by jobId (already-internal, ephemeral, NOT serialized). Added a thin getter `hasActiveNotify(jobId)` for constant-time exact lookup.
carrier_limit: the carrier `MessageTranslatorState.launchedBackgroundJobIds: Set<string>` is TURN-scoped ('all jobs launched by this turn'), NOT completion-scoped ('the job that THIS specific completion_result belongs to'). The completion_result message carries no jobId / toolCallId linking it to a specific run_commands invocation. Therefore the per-completion invariant `suppress(C) iff owner(C) == J AND outstanding(J)` is NOT reachable from the current production wire shape; what IS reachable is the TURN-LEVEL invariant `suppress(C) iff this turn launched at least one background job J AND hasActiveNotify(J) == true`.

predicate.after: suppress(C) iff ownedJobIds(C) is non-empty AND hasActiveNotify(jid) == true for some jid in ownedJobIds(C)
predicate.ownership_hint_carrier: MessageTranslatorState.launchedBackgroundJobIds: Set<string> (TURN-scoped, internal-only, ephemeral, cleared by clearTurnOutcome())
predicate.ownership_hint_writer: vscode-run-commands-tool.ts:790 (at the SAME seam as registerMarker)
